description: The image displays three pie charts comparing four categories across three difficulty levels labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," with the text "CoT" positioned below the middle chart. Each chart consists of four slices representing the same categories, which are identified by a shared legend on the right side of the image. Percentage labels are displayed directly inside each slice, and no slices are visually emphasized by being exploded or offset. In the "easy" chart, the largest slice is the olive brown N-K+ category at 45.9%, followed by the dark teal N+K+ category at 40.6%, the medium brown N-K- category at 10.1%, and the reddish-brown N+K- category at 3.3%. The "medium" chart shows the dark teal N+K+ category at 44.6%, closely followed by the olive brown N-K+ category at 44.3%, the medium brown N-K- category at 7.2%, and the reddish-brown N+K- category at 3.9%. Finally, in the "hard" chart, the medium brown N-K- category is the largest at 36.8%, followed by the olive brown N-K+ category at 36.2%, the dark teal N+K+ category at 20.1%, and the reddish-brown N+K- category at 7.0%. Across all three charts, the segments are arranged in a consistent clockwise order based on their categories rather than being sorted by descending size.
